description: ONE separate game UI sprite: a mysterious medieval arcane timekeeper, seen perfectly FRONT ON, centered, complete silhouette with transparent exterior. 256x256 canvas. Original polished 16-bit RPG pixel art with crisp pixels and deliberate clusters, no vector look. An upright circular astrolabe mounted on a small heavy carved stone foot. Weathered brass bezel with restrained ornamental corners, dark slate-blue inset face, a thin inset ring of small ancient fictional rune marks, two subtle dull teal gemstone accents. Symmetrical fixed outer casing, physical depth through pixel shading only. A large circular dark almost flat EMPTY CENTER, at least 104 pixels across, deliberately reserved for a live digital timer placed by the game engine. No clock hands crossing the center. No text, numbers, Roman numerals, lettering, hourglass or extra objects. Mechanical inner concentric brass ring surrounds the empty center and can rotate separately later. Only tiny muted sea-green lights in a few rune marks, same low brightness as highlights; no bright glow clouds, bloom, particles or floating debris. High contrast silhouette, muted warm brass and cool slate palette, readable at game size. Not a steampunk machine, not a reward badge. Keep the entire object inside the canvas with 10px transparent padding; no clipped extremities. One coherent sprite, no contact sheet, no background, no floor, no scene, no UI button.
